d: The Customer Experience Specialist is responsible for delivering effective, consistent service across all official company channels, including personalized support for VIP customers. The role also supports the operation of customer experience systems and analyzes their performance to identify improvements across AI-enabled solutions, automated workflows, the WhatsApp chatbot, and channel integrations. Time is split approximately equally between direct customer service and supporting and improving these systems.
q: Diploma or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communication, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.
Minimum three years of experience: at least two years in customer service and at least one year working with CRM, chatbot, or contact-center systems.
r: Handle customer inquiries, requests, and complaints across all official channels, including phone, email, company WhatsApp, social media, and the customer service platform. Meet approved service-level agreements and maintain consistent messaging and tone across channels.
Provide accurate information about the company’s projects, land offerings, products, services, promotions, and policies, and stay up to date on relevant changes.
Record all customer interactions, requests, and complaints accurately and on time in the customer service platform or customer relationship management (CRM) system.
Escalate complex cases to the relevant department or direct manager. Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to resolve cases and follow up through closure.

Monitor the company’s social media channels, online reviews, and mentions. Respond to comments and messages in line with the brand’s voice, and immediately escalate any issue that could affect the company’s reputation to the relevant team.
Follow up on after-sales requests, coordinate project handover appointments and site visits with the Sales and Projects teams, and confirm that customers are satisfied with the outcome.
Provide personalized, priority service to VIP and high-value customers, and keep the VIP customer register up to date.
Conduct customer satisfaction surveys and collect feedback to support ongoing service improvements.
Protect the confidentiality of customer data and comply with the company’s data protection policies.
Support customer journey mapping and help identify where customers encounter difficulties and how their experience can be improved.
Support the implementation and improvement of AI-enabled customer service tools, automated workflows, and the WhatsApp chatbot. Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT).

Review chatbot and automation performance, including the percentage of requests resolved through self-service and the percentage transferred to customer service agents. Recommend improvements to conversation flows, recognition of customer intent, and escalation rules.
Work with Marketing, IT, and vendors to improve the user experience and interfaces across customer touchpoints, digital platforms, and the CRM ticketing system.

Monitor the technical performance of communication channels and data flows between the telephony platform, such as Bevatel, WhatsApp, and the CRM system. Report issues to IT or the relevant vendor and follow up until they are resolved.
Prepare periodic analytical reports and dashboards on service tickets, complaints, channel performance, and automation outcomes. Present recommendations to management.
Forecast customer contact volumes during peak periods and project launches, plan for and manage demand, and maintain service levels across marketing and sales touchpoints.
Update user guides, document procedures for customer experience systems, and help train colleagues on new tools and workflows.

d: Dia Flower is seeking a skilled and dedicated Marketing Manager to lead our marketing efforts and drive brand growth in a competitive marketplace. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, and executing strategic marketing plans that align with our company goals and enhance our market presence. This role requires a combination of creative thinking, analytical skills, and strong leadership to oversee various marketing campaigns, manage cross-functional teams, and optimize promotional activities. As the Marketing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in nurturing customer relationships, increasing brand awareness, and leveraging market research to identify new opportunities. You will work closely with sales, product development, and executive teams to ensure cohesive messaging and maximize the impact of marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in marketing strategy, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. By joining Dia Flower, you will contribute to a dynamic company committed to delivering exceptional value to its customers and maintaining a leading position in the industry. This is an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional to advance their career and make a significant impact within our organization.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field; MBA preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing management or a similar role.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute successful marketing campaigns.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing tools and platforms, including SEO, SEM, and social media management.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proven analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with marketing software and CRM systems.
r: Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies to increase brand awareness and drive customer engagement.
Lead and coordinate marketing campaigns across digital, print, and social media channels.
Collaborate with product development and sales teams to align marketing objectives with business goals.
Conduct market research and analyze consumer trends to identify growth opportunities.
Manage marketing budgets and allocate resources efficiently to maximize ROI.
Oversee the creation of marketing materials, including advertisements, newsletters, and promotional content.
Monitor and report on the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and adjust strategies accordingly.
Supervise and mentor marketing staff to foster professional development and high performance.

d: Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Polisher, and finishes are well-maintained and visually appealing – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
q: What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member.
Specific Job Knowledge, Skills And Ability

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.
Proven experience and expertise in polishing, with a thorough understanding of techniques and methods for different surfaces.
Proficient in using hand tools and power tools relevant to polishing work.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to achieve high-quality finishes.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
CPR Certification and/or First Aid Training is an advantageous
r: Apply polishing paints and coatings to various surfaces throughout the hotel, including floors, walls, and furniture.
Prepare surfaces for polishing by cleaning, sanding, or buffing as needed to ensure optimal adhesion and finish.
Select appropriate polishing paints and coatings based on surface type, usage, and desired appearance.
Use painting and polishing equipment such as brushes, rollers, sprayers, and polishing machines safely and effectively.
Apply polishing paints and coatings evenly and accurately to achieve a smooth and consistent finish.
Follow manufacturer instructions and safety guidelines when handling and applying polishing paints and coatings.
Inspect finished surfaces for quality and touch up any imperfections or inconsistencies as necessary.
Coordinate with other members of the engineering team to schedule and prioritize polishing projects.
Maintain a clean and organized work environment, including proper storage and disposal of painting and polishing materials.
Adhere to health and safety regulations while working with painting and polishing chemicals and equipment.
Communicate effectively with engineering supervisors and colleagues regarding project progress and any issues encountered.
Stay updated on new polishing techniques, materials, and equipment to enhance skills and efficiency.

In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the supervisor based upon the particular requirements of the company
Providing input on material selection for optimal results.
Collaborating with other departments for scheduling projects.
Keeping records of materials used and project progress.
Collaborate with carpenters and other maintenance staff to assist in the repair or refurbishment of items before polishing, when necessary.
Supporting colleagues with tasks as needed.

q: •B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc in Civil Engineering or a related field.
•15 – 20 years of experience, including 7+ years in a senior management role, in civil works mainly for Substation, Tower Line and Underground Cable projects.
•Valid Kuwait Society of Engineers (KSE) membership and PMP certification are a must.
•Strong project leadership and execution, budgeting and cost control, planning and scheduling, QA/QC, reporting and presentation skills.
•Sound knowledge of industry safety aspects and local regulations; able to lead, coach and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
r: •Lead and oversee the execution of civil works for substations, overhead transmission lines (OHTL) and underground cable projects in line with approved scope, timelines and budget.

•Manage end-to-end delivery of substation civil infrastructure (equipment foundations, control buildings, cable trenches, drainage systems, access roads) and transmission line tower foundations in compliance with geotechnical reports and design specifications.
•Provide leadership to project teams, site engineers and subcontractors by setting clear objectives, monitoring performance and optimizing resource utilization.
•Oversee project financials, planning and scheduling: budget control, cost forecasting, material optimization and progress tracking to achieve milestones and a smooth project handover.
•Review and approve civil and structural designs, and ensure adherence to NCC standards, local authority regulations, client specifications and HSE policies across all phases.
•Evaluate subcontractor quotations, review quantity take-offs, BOQs and payment applications, and manage variations and claims related to civil works.
•Coordinate with clients, consultants and internal teams, review pre-tender site surveys, and report regularly to top management on project status, risks and mitigation plans.
